memoryBuilder.verseText: Everyone has sinned. Everyone needs God to help them.

sequence.prompt: What happened on the very sad day? Put it in order.

items.label: God said not to eat from one tree
The snake told a lie about God

matches.prompt: Match each one to what they did.

pairs.right: Came looking and called, 'Where are you?'

application.question: Everyone has done wrong things — everyone. What helps you most when you have done something wrong?
application.followUp: They hid in the trees — but God did not wait for them to come out. He came looking, and He called their name. He comes looking for you too.
